kikuyu: Lea aarĩ na maitho mataarĩ na hinya, no Rakeli oombĩtwo arĩ kĩĩrorerwa na aarĩ mũthaka.
english: Leah’s eyes were weak, but Rachel was beautiful in form and attractive.

kikuyu: Mũnabii, kana mũthĩnjĩri-Ngai, o na kana mũndũ ũngĩ o wothe angiuga atĩrĩ, ‘Ĩno nĩyo ndũmĩrĩri nditũ kuuma kũrĩ Jehova,’ niĩ nĩngaherithia mũndũ ũcio o hamwe na nyũmba yake.
english: As for the prophet, the priest, and the people, who say, ‘The message from Yahweh,’ I will even punish that man and his household.

kikuyu: Tūmīra dawa ya copper hīndī īrīa kwīna ūgunyu.
english: Use of copper sprays especially during wet season.

kikuyu: Jesũ aigua ũguo, akĩmeera atĩrĩ, “Andũ arĩa agima mĩĩrĩ ti o mabataragio nĩ ndagĩtarĩ, no nĩ arĩa arũaru.
english: When Jesus heard it, he said to them, “Those who are healthy have no need for a physician, but those who are sick do.

kikuyu: Mwathani Jehova ekuuga ũũ: Rĩrĩa thĩ yothe ĩgaakorwo ĩgĩcanjamũka, nĩngatũma ũkire ihooru.
english: The Lord Yahweh says: “When the whole earth rejoices, I will make you desolate.

kikuyu: Atĩrĩrĩ, angĩkorwo inyuĩ nĩmwakuire hamwe na Kristũ, na mũgĩtigana na irĩra iria cia ndũire cia thĩ ĩno-rĩ, nĩ kĩĩ gĩtũmaga mwathĩkĩre mawatho mayo, ta mũtũire mũrĩ a thĩ?
english: If you died with Christ from the elemental spirits of the world, why, as though living in the world, do you subject yourselves to ordinances,

kikuyu: Nake akĩmũthika kũu Moabi gĩtuamba kĩrĩa kĩangʼetheire Bethi-Peori, no nginya ũmũthĩ gũtirĩ mũndũ ũũĩ harĩa mbĩrĩra yake ĩrĩ.
english: He buried him in the valley in the land of Moab opposite Beth Peor, but no man knows where his tomb is to this day.

kikuyu: Tondũ nĩnyendete maathani maku gũkĩra thahabu, ngamenda mũno gũkĩra thahabu ĩrĩa therie,
english: Therefore I love your commandments more than gold, yes, more than pure gold.

kikuyu: Nao makĩmwĩra atĩrĩ, “Jusufu arĩ o muoyo! Na nĩwe mwathi wa bũrũri wothe wa Misiri.” Jakubu akĩgegeara; akĩaga kũmetĩkia.
english: They told him, saying, “Joseph is still alive, and he is ruler over all the land of Egypt.” His heart fainted, for he didn’t believe them.

kikuyu: Ngūkū ndwaru ītungatagwo atīa?
english: How to handle sick chicken?

kikuyu: Maũndũ maya mekĩkire nĩgeetha ciugo iria Jesũ aarĩtie akĩonania mũthemba wa gĩkuũ kĩrĩa agaakua ihingio.
english: that the word of Jesus might be fulfilled, which he spoke, signifying by what kind of death he should die.

kikuyu: Na rĩrĩ, mũthamaki wa Suriata nĩathĩte anene ake mĩrongo ĩtatũ na eerĩ a ngaari cia ita, akoiga atĩrĩ, “Mũtikarũe na mũndũ o na ũmwe, mũnene kana mũnini, tiga o mũthamaki wa Isiraeli.”
english: Now the king of Syria had commanded the thirty-two captains of his chariots, saying, “Don’t fight with small nor great, except only with the king of Israel.”

kikuyu: Nyeki nĩĩhoohaga namo mahũa magaitĩka, no kiugo kĩa Ngai witũ gĩtũũraga nginya tene.”
english: The grass withers, the flower fades; but the word of our God stands forever.”

kikuyu: Mĩkanda yaku nĩmĩregeru, na mũtĩ ũrĩa mũraaya wa marikabu ti mũrũmu, naguo taama wa kũmĩtwarithia timũtambũrũku. Hĩndĩ ĩyo indo nyingĩ cia ndaho nĩ ikaagayanwo, o na andũ arĩa mathuaga nĩmagekuuĩra indo cia ndaho.
english: Your rigging is untied. They couldn’t strengthen the foot of their mast. They couldn’t spread the sail. Then the prey of a great plunder was divided. The lame took the prey.

kikuyu: Nyama ciothe cia igongona rĩu ĩngĩtigara ĩkinyie mũthenya wa gatatũ-rĩ, no nginya ĩcinwo na mwaki.
english: but what remains of the meat of the sacrifice on the third day shall be burned with fire.

kikuyu: Īka īkūraga kabici cigana atia?
english: What is the average yield of cabbages per īka?

kikuyu: othe magĩcooka bũrũri wa Juda kũrĩ Gedalia kũu Mizipa, moimĩte mabũrũri-inĩ mothe marĩa maahurunjũkĩire. Nao magĩĩthondekera ndibei nyingĩ, o na makĩgetha matunda maingĩ ma hĩndĩ ya riũa.
english: then all the Jews returned out of all places where they were driven, and came to the land of Judah, to Gedaliah, to Mizpah, and gathered very much wine and summer fruits.

kikuyu: Nīmaūndū marīkū ma bata gūthingatithia rīrīa ūgwaka nyūmba ya ngūkū?
english: What are the requirements to observe when constructing a chicken house?

kikuyu: “Atha andũ a Isiraeli mahe Alawii matũũra mao ma gũtũũraga kuuma kũrĩ igai rĩrĩa andũ a Isiraeli makegwatĩra. Na macooke mamahe ithaka cia kũrĩithia mahiũ mao gũkuhĩ na matũũra macio.
english: “Command the children of Israel to give to the Levites cities to dwell in out of their inheritance. You shall give pasture lands for the cities around them to the Levites.

kikuyu: Betha ĩrĩa yarehirwo nĩ mũingĩ ũrĩa watarirwo hĩndĩ ya itarana yarĩ taranda 100 na cekeri 1,775,* kũringana na cekeri ya handũ-harĩa-haamũre,
english: The silver of those who were counted of the congregation was one hundred talents† and one thousand seven hundred seventy-five shekels,‡ according to the shekel of the sanctuary:

kikuyu: Hihi nĩndamũhatĩrĩirie na ũndũ wa mũndũ o na ũmwe wa arĩa ndamũtũmĩire?
english: Did I take advantage of you by anyone of those whom I have sent to you?

kikuyu: Matikagaya igai gatagatĩ ka ariũ a ithe wao; nĩgũkorwo Jehova nĩwe igai rĩao, o ta ũrĩa aamerĩire.
english: They shall have no inheritance among their brothers. Yahweh is their inheritance, as he has spoken to them.

kikuyu: O gĩtugĩ kĩmwe gĩacio kĩarĩ kĩa mĩkono ikũmi na ĩnana* kũraiha, na mĩkono ikũmi na ĩĩrĩ† gũthiũrũrũka; na o kĩmwe gĩacio kĩarĩ na ũtungu wa ciara inya, na kĩarĩ na irima gatagatĩ.
english: As for the pillars, the height of the one pillar was eighteen cubits;† and a line of twelve cubits encircled it; and its thickness was four fingers. It was hollow.

kikuyu: Nao anene a ngʼongo, o mũndũ mweri wake nĩarehagĩra Mũthamaki Solomoni mahũthĩro ma kũmũigana hamwe na arĩa othe mookaga metha-inĩ yake. Ningĩ magatigĩrĩra atĩ gũtirĩ kĩndũ o na kĩmwe kĩagaga.
english: Those officers provided food for King Solomon, and for all who came to King Solomon’s table, every man in his month. They let nothing be lacking.

kikuyu: Nĩgũkorwo Alawii nĩmatiganĩirie ũrĩithio wao na indo ciothe, magĩũka Juda na Jerusalemu, nĩgũkorwo Jeroboamu na ariũ ake nĩmamagiririe kũruta wĩra ta athĩnjĩri-Ngai a Jehova.
english: For the Levites left their pasture lands and their possessions, and came to Judah and Jerusalem; for Jeroboam and his sons cast them off, that they should not execute the priest’s office to Yahweh.

kikuyu: No Hamoru akĩmeera atĩrĩ, “Ngoro ya mũrũ wakwa Shekemu nĩĩguucĩrĩirio nĩ mwarĩ wanyu. Ndamũthaitha ĩtĩkĩrai amũhikie atuĩke mũtumia wake.
english: Hamor talked with them, saying, “The soul of my son, Shechem, longs for your daughter. Please give her to him as a wife.

kikuyu: Magĩkĩgemia igũrũ na mĩena yothe o na hĩa ciakĩo na thahabu therie na magĩgĩtiriha na mũcibi wa thahabu ũgĩgĩthiũrũrũkĩria.
english: He overlaid it with pure gold: its top, its sides around it, and its horns. He made a gold molding around it.

kikuyu: Ariũ a Lotani maarĩ: Hori na Homamu. Nake Timina aarĩ mwarĩ wa nyina na Lotani.
english: The sons of Lotan: Hori and Homam; and Timna was Lotan’s sister.

kikuyu: Matukũ marĩa magooka-rĩ, Jakubu nĩakagĩa na mĩri, Isiraeli agaathundũka arute kĩro, aiyũrie thĩ yothe maciaro.
english: In days to come, Jacob will take root. Israel will blossom and bud. They will fill the surface of the world with fruit.

kikuyu: Arĩriai itũũra rĩa Jerusalemu na ũhooreri, na mwanĩrĩre, mũrĩĩre atĩrĩ, wĩra warĩo mũritũ nĩũthirĩte, na nĩrĩrekeirwo mehia marĩo, o na ningĩ atĩ nĩrĩherithĩtio nĩ guoko kwa Jehova maita meerĩ nĩ ũndũ wa mehia marĩo mothe.
english: “Speak comfortably to Jerusalem, and call out to her that her warfare is accomplished, that her iniquity is pardoned, that she has received of Yahweh’s hand double for all her sins.”

kikuyu: no rĩrĩ, inyuĩ andũ a Akeni nĩmũkanangwo hĩndĩ ĩrĩa Ashuri makaamũtaha.”
english: Nevertheless Kain shall be wasted, until Asshur carries you away captive.”

kikuyu: Cookia rũhiũ njora thĩinĩ. Ũrĩ kũu wee wombĩirwo, o kũu bũrũri-inĩ ũcio wa maithe manyu, nĩkuo ngaagũtuĩra ciira.
english: Cause it to return into its sheath. In the place where you were created, in the land of your birth, I will judge you.

kikuyu: Na aakinya harĩ Simoni Petero, Petero akĩmũũria atĩrĩ, “Hĩ, Mwathani, wee nĩwe ũgũũthambia nyarĩrĩ?”
english: Then he came to Simon Peter. He said to him, “Lord, do you wash my feet?”

kikuyu: Rĩrĩa ihinda rĩake rĩakinyire rĩa gũciara-rĩ, kwarĩ na tũhĩĩ twĩrĩ twa mahatha nda yake.
english: In the time of her travail, behold, twins were in her womb.

kikuyu: Nake mũraika ũcio akĩĩra andũ-a-nja acio atĩrĩ, “Inyuĩ-rĩ, tigai gwĩtigĩra, nĩgũkorwo nĩnjũũĩ atĩ nĩ Jesũ ũrĩa ũraambirwo mũtĩ-igũrũ mũracaria.
english: The angel answered the women, “Don’t be afraid, for I know that you seek Jesus, who has been crucified.

kikuyu: ndamatooreria thũ ciao o na ihenya, na njũkĩrĩre andũ arĩa marĩ muku nao na ũndũ wa guoko gwakwa!
english: I would soon subdue their enemies, and turn my hand against their adversaries.

kikuyu: Ndamũthaitha, inyuĩ ariũ na aarĩ a Ithe witũ, tuĩkai ta niĩ, nĩgũkorwo niĩ nduĩkĩte ta inyuĩ. Mũtirĩ mwanjĩka ũũru.
english: I beg you, brothers, become as I am, for I also have become as you are. You did me no wrong,

kikuyu: Nī thumu ūrīku mwega mūgūnda īnī wa marigū?
english: Which is better for banana production: chicken or cow manure?

kikuyu: Thiiaga njirĩte biũ, no ti ũndũ wa kũhĩa nĩ riũa; ngarũgama kĩũngano-inĩ ngakaya ndeithio.
english: I go mourning without the sun. I stand up in the assembly, and cry for help.

kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ ũcio athuuri na anene arĩa maatũũraga itũũra-inĩ inene rĩa Nabothu magĩĩka o ta ũrĩa Jezebeli aathanĩte marũa-inĩ macio aamaandĩkĩire.
english: The men of his city, even the elders and the nobles who lived in his city, did as Jezebel had instructed them in the letters which she had written and sent to them.

kikuyu: Rĩrĩa ũgaakaya ũkĩenda ũteithio-rĩ, mĩhianano ĩyo ya kũhooywo ũnganĩtie-rĩ, nĩĩgagĩkũhonokia! Rũhuho nĩrũkamĩkuua yothe, yũmbũrwo, yeherio nĩ mĩhũmũ mĩtheri. No rĩrĩ, mũndũ ũrĩa ũnduuaga rĩũrĩro rĩake-rĩ, nĩwe ũkaagaya bũrũri, o na egwatĩre kĩrĩma gĩakwa kĩrĩa kĩamũre.”
english: When you cry, let those whom you have gathered deliver you, but the wind will take them. A breath will carry them all away, but he who takes refuge in me will possess the land, and will inherit my holy mountain.”

kikuyu: Mũthĩnjĩri-Ngai acooke acithũngũthie mbere ya Jehova, ituĩke igongona rĩa gũthũngũthio; nĩ nyamũre, na nĩ cia mũthĩnjĩri-Ngai, hamwe na gĩthũri kĩrĩa gĩthũngũthĩtio, o na kĩero kĩrĩa kĩrutĩtwo. Thuutha ũcio Mũnaziri no anyue ndibei.
english: and the priest shall wave them for a wave offering before Yahweh. They are holy for the priest, together with the breast that is waved and the thigh that is offered. After that the Nazirite may drink wine.

kikuyu: Maarĩkia kuuma gatarũ-inĩ, o rĩmwe andũ makĩmenya Jesũ.
english: When they had come out of the boat, immediately the people recognized him,

kikuyu: Jonathani mamawe wa Daudi aarĩ mũheani kĩrĩra, mũndũ mũmenyi maũndũ na mwandĩki- marũa. Nake Jehieli mũrũ wa Hakimoni nĩwe wamenyagĩrĩra ariũ a mũthamaki.
english: Also Jonathan, David’s uncle, was a counselor, a man of understanding, and a scribe. Jehiel the son of Hachmoni was with the king’s sons.

kikuyu: nao andũ othe makĩgeria kũmũhutia, tondũ hinya nĩwoimaga thĩinĩ wake na ũkamahonia othe.
english: All the multitude sought to touch him, for power came out of him and healed them all.

kikuyu: Na rĩrĩ, Zedekia mũrũ wa Kenaana nĩathondekete hĩa cia kĩgera, nake akiuga atĩrĩ, “Jehova ekuuga ũũ: ‘Ici nĩcio mũgatheeca Asuriata nacio nginya mũmaniine.’ ”
english: Zedekiah the son of Chenaanah made himself horns of iron, and said, “Yahweh says, ‘With these you will push the Syrians, until they are consumed.’ ”

kikuyu: Ningĩ mũtikananeane ciĩga cia mĩĩrĩ yanyu mehia-inĩ, atĩ nĩguo ituĩke ta indo cia kũhũthĩrwo cia kwagana nacio, no nĩ kaba mwĩheanage kũrĩ Ngai, mũhaana ta andũ marutĩtwo gĩkuũ-inĩ makarehwo muoyo-inĩ na mũneanage ciĩga icio cia mĩĩrĩ yanyu kũrĩ we nĩguo ituĩke ta indo cia kũhũthĩrwo na gwĩka maũndũ ma ũthingu.
english: Also, do not present your members to sin as instruments of unrighteousness, but present yourselves to God as alive from the dead, and your members as instruments of righteousness to God.

kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ ũcio Musa akiuga atĩrĩ, “Jehova ekuuga ũũ: ‘Kũrĩ ta ũtukũ gatagatĩ nĩngatuĩkania bũrũri wa Misiri wothe.
english: Moses said, “This is what Yahweh says: ‘About midnight I will go out into the middle of Egypt,

kikuyu: Itina cia itugĩ icio ciarĩ cia gĩcango. Tũcuurio na tũmĩkwa tũrĩa twekĩrĩtwo itugĩ-inĩ twarĩ twa betha na igũrũ wacio ciagemetio na betha; Nĩ ũndũ ũcio itugĩ ciothe cia nja ĩyo ciarĩ na tũmĩkwa twa betha.
english: The sockets for the pillars were of bronze. The hooks of the pillars and their fillets were of silver. Their capitals were overlaid with silver. All the pillars of the court had silver bands.

kikuyu: Mwaka wa ikũmi na ĩna wa wathani wa Mũthamaki Hezekia, Senakeribu mũthamaki wa Ashuri nĩatharĩkĩire matũũra manene mothe marĩa mairigĩirwo na thingo cia hinya ma Juda, na akĩmatunyana.
english: Now in the fourteenth year of King Hezekiah, Sennacherib king of Assyria attacked all of the fortified cities of Judah and captured them.

kikuyu: Ngai nĩatũmire ũcio ũtaarĩ na wĩhia atuĩke mwĩhia nĩ ũndũ witũ, nĩgeetha thĩinĩ wake tũtuĩke ũthingu wa Ngai.
english: For him who knew no sin he made to be sin on our behalf, so that in him we might become the righteousness of God.

kikuyu: Nao makĩmwĩra atĩrĩ, “No rĩrĩ Rabii, o rĩu ica ikuhĩ Ayahudi marageragia gũkũhũũra na mahiga nyuguto, na rĩu ũrenda gũcooka kuo?”
english: The disciples asked him, “Rabbi, the Jews were just trying to stone you. Are you going there again?”

kikuyu: Nyũngũ nĩ ya gũthererio betha, na kĩrugutĩro nĩ gĩa gũthererio thahabu, no mũndũ athimagwo na igweta rĩrĩa agwetagwo narĩo.
english: The crucible is for silver, and the furnace for gold; but man is refined by his praise.

kikuyu: Wendo wake ũtathiraga-rĩ, nĩkũbuĩria ũbuĩrĩtie nginya tene? Kĩĩranĩro gĩake gĩgũtũũra gĩtahingĩte nginya tene?
english: Has his loving kindness vanished forever? Does his promise fail for generations?

kikuyu: Makĩmatumĩra iremba cia gatani njega, na tũkũbia twa gatani, na thuruarĩ cia thĩinĩ cia gatani ĩrĩa yogothetwo wega.
english: the turban of fine linen, the linen headbands of fine linen, the linen trousers of fine twined linen,

kikuyu: Na mũrĩ hau, mũkenage mũrĩ mbere ya Jehova Ngai wanyu, inyuĩ ene, na ariũ anyu, na airĩtu anyu, na ndungata cianyu cia arũme na cia andũ-a-nja, na Alawii a kuuma matũũra-inĩ manyu arĩa matarĩ na mĩgũnda kana igai rĩao ene.
english: You shall rejoice before Yahweh your God—you, and your sons, your daughters, your male servants, your female servants, and the Levite who is within your gates, because he has no portion nor inheritance with you.

kikuyu: Wee ũrũmĩrĩire mĩthiĩre ya mwarĩ wa nyũkwa; nĩ ũndũ ũcio nĩngakũnengera gĩkombe gĩake ũkĩnyiite na guoko gwaku.
english: You have walked in the way of your sister; therefore I will give her cup into your hand.’

kikuyu: Wee Ngai, gĩkũũre andũ a Isiraeli, moime mathĩĩna-inĩ mao mothe!
english: God, redeem Israel out of all his troubles.

kikuyu: Ikarai nyũmba ĩyo, mũrĩĩage na mũkanyua kĩrĩa gĩothe marĩmũheaga, nĩgũkorwo mũruti wĩra nĩagĩrĩirwo kũheagwo mũcaara wake. Mutikoimage nyũmba ĩmwe mũgathiĩ ĩrĩa ĩngĩ.
english: Remain in that same house, eating and drinking the things they give, for the laborer is worthy of his wages. Don’t go from house to house.

kikuyu: “Arĩria andũ a Isiraeli, ũmeere atĩrĩ: ‘Ici nĩcio ciathĩ ciakwa iria ciathanĩtwo, o iria ciathanĩtwo cia Jehova, iria mũkaahunjanĩria ũhoro wacio atĩ nĩ ciũngano theru.
english: “Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘The set feasts of Yahweh, which you shall proclaim to be holy convocations, even these are my set feasts.

kikuyu: nĩũhĩtĩtienĩũndũwathakameĩrĩaũitĩte, nanĩũthaahĩtionĩmĩhiananoĩrĩaũthondekete. Nĩũtũmĩte matukũ maku makinye mũthia, o naguo mũthia wa mĩaka yaku nĩmũkinyu. Nĩ ũndũ ũcio nĩngatũma ũtuĩke kĩndũ kĩmeneku harĩ ndũrĩrĩ, na kĩndũ gĩa gũthekererwo nĩ mabũrũri macio mothe.
english: You have become guilty in your blood that you have shed, and are defiled in your idols which you have made! You have caused your days to draw near, and have come to the end of your years. Therefore I have made you a reproach to the nations, and a mocking to all the countries.

kikuyu: “ ‘Mwarĩ wa mũthĩnjĩri-Ngai angĩĩthaahia na gũtuĩka mũmaraya, nĩaconorithĩtie ithe; no nginya acinwo na mwaki.
english: “ ‘The daughter of any priest, if she profanes herself by playing the prostitute, she profanes her father. She shall be burned with fire.

kikuyu: Ndũkanatunye arĩa athĩĩni indo ciao tondũ wa ũthĩĩni wao, na ndũkanahinyĩrĩrie arĩa abatari ciira-inĩ,
english: Don’t exploit the poor because he is poor; and don’t crush the needy in court;

kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ ũcio, kĩmenye atĩ ti ũthingu waku ũtũmĩte Jehova Ngai waku akũhe bũrũri ũcio mwega ũwĩgwatĩre ũtuĩke waku, nĩgũkorwo inyuĩ mũrĩ andũ momĩtie ngingo.

kikuyu: No nginya thiĩ na mbere na kwĩraha. O na gũtuĩka gwĩka ũguo gũtirĩ uumithio-rĩ, rĩu nĩngwaria ũhoro wa maũndũ marĩa ndanonio nĩ Mwathani, na marĩa ndanaguũrĩrio nĩwe.
english: It is doubtless not profitable for me to boast, but I will come to visions and revelations of the Lord.

kikuyu: Magĩcooka magĩthondekera hema kĩhumbĩri kĩa njũa cia ndũrũme itoboketio rangi-inĩ mũtune igatunĩha, na igũrũ wakĩo hakĩhumbĩrwo na njũa cia pomboo.
english: He made a covering for the tent of rams’ skins dyed red, and a covering of sea cow hides above.

kikuyu: Mũndũ ũcio akaigĩrĩra guoko gwake igũrũ rĩa mũtwe wa nyamũ ĩyo ya iruta rĩa njino, nayo nĩĩgetĩkĩrwo handũ-inĩ hake, ĩtuĩke ya kũmũhoroheria.
english: He shall lay his hand on the head of the burnt offering, and it shall be accepted for him to make atonement for him.

kikuyu: Ũkaamarehe thĩinĩ na ũmahaande kĩrĩma-inĩ kĩa igai rĩaku, o handũ harĩa, Wee Jehova, wombire hatuĩke gĩikaro gĩaku, handũ-harĩa-haamũre, harĩa Wee Jehova, wahaandire na moko maku.
english: You will bring them in, and plant them in the mountain of your inheritance, the place, Yahweh, which you have made for yourself to dwell in: the sanctuary, Lord, which your hands have established.

kikuyu: Rĩrĩa ũgaatoonya bũrũri ũrĩa Jehova Ngai waku egũkũhe ũrĩ igai, na ũwĩgwatĩre na ũtũũre kuo,
english: It shall be, when you have come in to the land which Yahweh your God gives you for an inheritance, possess it, and dwell in it,

kikuyu: Ti- itherũ nĩmũkũririkana, inyuĩ ariũ na aarĩ a Ithe witũ, wĩra witũ wa hinya na kwĩnogia gwitũ; twarutaga wĩra ũtukũ na mũthenya nĩguo tũtigatuĩke mũrigo harĩ mũndũ o na ũrĩkũ hĩndĩ ĩrĩa twamũhunjagĩria Ũhoro-ũrĩa-Mwega wa Ngai.
english: For you remember, brothers, our labor and travail; for working night and day, that we might not burden any of you, we preached to you the Good News of God.

kikuyu: No eciirĩrĩre na ciugo cia tũhũ, kana na mĩario ĩtarĩ bata?
english: Should he reason with unprofitable talk, or with speeches with which he can do no good?

kikuyu: Rĩrĩa aakinyire hakuhĩ na njĩra ĩrĩa ĩikũrũkagĩra Kĩrĩma-inĩ kĩa Mĩtamaiyũ, gĩkundi gĩothe kĩa arutwo gĩkĩambĩrĩria kũgooca Ngai, andũ makĩanĩrĩra makenete nĩ ũndũ wa ciama iria ciothe moonete makiuga atĩrĩ:
english: As he was now getting near, at the descent of the Mount of Olives, the whole multitude of the disciples began to rejoice and praise God with a loud voice for all the mighty works which they had seen,

kikuyu: o nginya rĩrĩa ithuothe tũkaagĩa na ũrũmwe ũhoro-inĩ wa gwĩtĩkia o na wa kũmenya Mũrũ wa Ngai, na tũtuĩke agima o nginya tũgĩe na ũgima mũkinyanĩru kũna o ta ũrĩa Kristũ ahaana.
english: until we all attain to the unity of the faith and of the knowledge of the Son of God, to a full grown man, to the measure of the stature of the fullness of Christ,

kikuyu: “No ithuĩ nĩtũmangʼaũranĩtie; Heshiboni kwanangĩtwo guothe nginya o Diboni. Tũmamomorete tũgakinya Nofa, itũũra rĩrĩa rĩkuhanĩrĩirie na Medeba.”
english: We have shot at them. Heshbon has perished even to Dibon. We have laid waste even to Nophah, Which reaches to Medeba.”

kikuyu: nĩgeetha mũtuĩke ariũ a Ithe wanyu ũrĩa ũrĩ igũrũ. Atũmaga riũa rĩake rĩrathĩre arĩa ooru na arĩa ega, na akoiria mbura kũrĩ arĩa athingu na kũrĩ arĩa matarĩ athingu.
english: that you may be children of your Father who is in heaven. For he makes his sun to rise on the evil and the good, and sends rain on the just and the unjust.

kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ ũcio, Wee Jehova, nĩndĩrĩkũgoocaga ndĩ gatagatĩ ka ndũrĩrĩ, ndĩrĩinaga ngagooca rĩĩtwa rĩaku.
english: Therefore I will give thanks to you, Yahweh, among the nations, and will sing praises to your name.

kikuyu: Wee Jehova, mawatho maku maikaraga marĩ marũmu; naguo ũtheru ũgũtũũra ũgemetie nyũmba yaku matukũ matarĩ mũthia.
english: Your statutes stand firm. Holiness adorns your house, Yahweh, forever more.

kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ ũcio Musa akĩũngania mbeeca cia gũkũũra andũ acio maakĩrĩte mũigana wa andũ arĩa maakũũrĩtwo nĩ Alawii.
english: Moses took the redemption money from those who exceeded the number of those who were redeemed by the Levites;

kikuyu: O ta ũrĩa kwandĩkĩtwo atĩrĩ: “Tũtindaga tũkĩũragwo o mũthenya wothe nĩ ũndũ waku; tũtuuagwo ta ngʼondu cia gũthĩnjwo.”
english: Even as it is written, “For your sake we are killed all day long. We were accounted as sheep for the slaughter.”*

kikuyu: No wee-rĩ, nĩngakuoya, na nĩũgathamaka maũndũ-inĩ mothe marĩa ngoro yaku ĩkeerirĩria; nĩũgatuĩka mũthamaki wa Isiraeli.
english: I will take you, and you shall reign according to all that your soul desires, and shall be king over Israel.

kikuyu: Na rĩrĩ, thuutha wa mĩaka ĩtatũ, nĩndambatire Jerusalemu nĩguo tũkamenyane na Petero, na ngĩikara nake matukũ ikũmi na matano.
english: Then after three years I went up to Jerusalem to visit Peter, and stayed with him fifteen days.

kikuyu: Nake Jesũ akĩmũcookeria atĩrĩ, “Ingĩenda atũũre muoyo nginya rĩrĩa ngacooka-rĩ, ũcio ũkĩrĩ ũhoro waku? Wee no nginya ũnũmĩrĩre.”
english: Jesus said to him, “If I desire that he stay until I come, what is that to you? You follow me.”

kikuyu: Mwaka-inĩ wa ĩna kuuma Jehoiakimu mũrũ wa Josia atuĩka mũthamaki wa Juda-rĩ, ndũmĩrĩri ĩno nĩyakinyĩire Jeremia yumĩte harĩ Jehova, akĩĩrwo ũũ:
english: In the fourth year of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah, king of Judah, this word came to Jeremiah from Yahweh, saying,

kikuyu: wa mĩrongo ĩĩrĩ na ĩna wagũĩrĩire Romamuti-Ezeri, na ariũ ake, na andũ a nyũmba yao, maarĩ andũ 12.
english: for the twenty-fourth to Romamti-Ezer, his sons and his brothers, twelve.

kikuyu: Wee-rĩ, to gũthiĩ wathiire na mĩthiĩre yao na ũkĩrũmĩrĩra mĩtugo yao ĩrĩ magigi, no mĩthiĩre-inĩ yaku yothe nĩwahiũhire gũthũka kũmakĩra.
english: Yet you have not walked in their ways, nor done their abominations; but soon you were more corrupt than they in all your ways.

kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ ũcio Hamoru na mũriũ Shekemu magĩthiĩ kĩhingo-inĩ gĩa itũũra rĩao inene makaarie na andũ ao a itũũra rĩu.*
english: Hamor and Shechem, his son, came to the gate of their city, and talked with the men of their city, saying,

kikuyu: “Mũtigatangĩke ngoro, mwĩhokei Ngai; o na niĩ mũnjĩhoke.
english: “Don’t let your heart be troubled. Believe in God. Believe also in me.

kikuyu: Wee Ngai-rĩ, ririkana atĩ muoyo wakwa no ta mĩhũmũ; namo maitho makwa matigacooka kuona ũndũ mwega rĩngĩ.
english: Oh remember that my life is a breath. My eye will no more see good.

kikuyu: Rĩu-rĩ, hĩndĩ ya kũriũka-rĩ, mũtumia ũcio agaakorwo arĩ wa ũ harĩ acio mũgwanja, tondũ othe nĩmamũhikĩtie?”
english: In the resurrection therefore, whose wife will she be of the seven? For they all had her.”

kikuyu: “Mũrũ wa mũndũ, erekeria ũthiũ waku kũrĩ Firaũni mũthamaki wa Misiri, ũmũũkĩrĩre, na ũmũrathĩre ũhoro wa kũmũũkĩrĩra na wa gũũkĩrĩra bũrũri wothe wa Misiri.
english: “Son of man, set your face against Pharaoh king of Egypt, and prophesy against him and against all Egypt.

kikuyu: nao ti akuũku wega, na matitĩĩaga ũhoro ũrĩa mũrĩĩkanĩre, na nĩ ooru mũno, na matirĩ tha.
english: without understanding, covenant breakers, without natural affection, unforgiving, unmerciful;

kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ ũcio ndamũthaitha mwĩgerekanie na niĩ.
english: I beg you therefore, be imitators of me.

kikuyu: Akĩmwĩra atĩrĩ, “Thiĩ ũgethambe Karia-inĩ ga Siloamu” (narĩo rĩĩtwa Siloamu nĩ kuuga Gũtũmwo.)* Nĩ ũndũ ũcio mũndũ ũcio agĩthiĩ na agĩĩthamba, na agĩũka mũciĩ akĩonaga.
english: and said to him, “Go, wash in the pool of Siloam” (which means “Sent”). So he went away, washed, and came back seeing.

kikuyu: Ūrūrū ūngīkira, gīkuo kīa hi na hi hari ngūkū gīkoneka.
english: In very severe cases, sudden death of birds occurs.

kikuyu: Moima Makelothu magĩthiĩ makĩamba hema ciao Tahathu.
english: They traveled from Makheloth, and encamped in Tahath.

kikuyu: Wee Jehova, ngoro yakwa ndĩrĩ na mwĩgaatho, o na maitho makwa ti ma mwĩtũũgĩrio; niĩ ndirũmbũyanagia na maũndũ manene, o na kana maũndũ ma magegania marĩa mangĩrĩte.
english: Yahweh, my heart isn’t arrogant, nor my eyes lofty; nor do I concern myself with great matters, or things too wonderful for me.

kikuyu: Mũndũ ũrĩa ũtendaga gũtũũrania na andũ arũmagĩrĩra o merirĩria make; ningĩ areganaga na matua mothe ma ũũgĩ ũrĩa mũkinyanĩru.
english: A man who isolates himself pursues selfishness, and defies all sound judgment.

kikuyu: Maguta manungi wega na ũbumba irehagĩra ngoro ya mũndũ gĩkeno, na noguo wega wa mũrata wa mũndũ wĩkaga akĩmũhe ũtaaro wake wa ma.
english: Perfume and incense bring joy to the heart; so does earnest counsel from a man’s friend.

kikuyu: ngakũhũthĩra kũhehenja mũndũ mũrũme na mũndũ-wa-nja, ngakũhũthĩra kũhehenja mũndũ mũkũrũ na ũrĩa mwĩthĩ, o na ngakũhũthĩra kũhehenja mwanake na mũirĩtu,
english: With you I will break in pieces the chariot and him who rides therein. With you I will break in pieces man and woman. With you I will break in pieces the old man and the youth. With you I will break in pieces the young man and the virgin.

kikuyu: No rĩrĩ, arĩa magaatuuo aagĩrĩru a gũkinya ihinda rĩu o na gũkinyanĩrio ihinda rĩa kũriũka kwa arĩa akuũ-rĩ, acio matikahikanagia o na kana mahikanagie.
english: But those who are considered worthy to attain to that age and the resurrection from the dead neither marry nor are given in marriage.

kikuyu: Nĩagĩrĩire kwĩrwo atĩ nĩngwenda kwaria? Nĩ kũrĩ mũndũ o na ũ ũngiuga amerio?
english: Will it be told him that I would speak? Or should a man wish that he were swallowed up?

kikuyu: Nacio ciĩraga ooni-maũndũ atĩrĩ, “Mũtigatuonere maũndũ mangĩ!” na ikeera anabii atĩrĩ, “Tigai gũtũrathĩra maũndũ ma ũhoro wa ma! Twĩragei maũndũ marĩa mangĩtũkenia, na mũtũrathagĩre maũndũ ma maheeni.
english: who tell the seers, “Don’t see!” and the prophets, “Don’t prophesy to us right things. Tell us pleasant things. Prophesy deceits.

kikuyu: Rekei ũhoro wa Kristũ ũtũũrage ũingĩhĩte mũno thĩinĩ wanyu, mũkĩrutanaga na mũgĩtaaranaga mũndũ na ũrĩa ũngĩ mũrĩ na ũũgĩ mũingĩ, o mũkĩinaga thaburi, na nyĩmbo cia Ngai, o na nyĩmbo cia kĩĩroho, mũrĩ na ngaatho harĩ Ngai ngoro- inĩ cianyu.
english: Let the word of Christ dwell in you richly; in all wisdom teaching and admonishing one another with psalms, hymns, and spiritual songs, singing with grace in your heart to the Lord.

kikuyu: Nyama ciacio nĩ ciaku, o ta ũrĩa gĩthũri kĩa igongona rĩa gũthũngũthio na kĩero kĩa ũrĩo irĩ ciaku.
english: Their meat shall be yours, as the wave offering breast and as the right thigh, it shall be yours.

kikuyu: Nĩgũkorwo Jehova arĩ na mũthenya wa kwĩrĩhĩria, arĩ na mwaka wa kũherithania, nĩguo arũĩrĩre kĩhooto gĩa Zayuni.
english: For Yahweh has a day of vengeance, a year of recompense for the cause of Zion.

kikuyu: nake wa gatano aarĩ Shefatia mũrũ wa Abitali; nake wa gatandatũ aarĩ Ithireamu ũrĩa aaciarĩirwo nĩ mũtumia wake Egila.
english: the fifth, Shephatiah of Abital; the sixth, Ithream by Eglah his wife:

kikuyu: No rĩrĩ, andũ aya nĩmatahĩtwo na magatunywo indo, othe manyiitĩtwo na mĩtego marima-inĩ, o na makahithwo njeera thĩinĩ. Matuĩkĩte ta nyamũ cia kũguĩmwo, na gũtirĩ mũndũ ũngĩmahonokia; maikarĩte marĩ atahe, na gũtirĩ mũndũ ũngiuga atĩrĩ, “Nĩmacookio kwao.”
english: But this is a robbed and plundered people. All of them are snared in holes, and they are hidden in prisons. They have become captives, and no one delivers, and a plunder, and no one says, ‘Restore them!’

kikuyu: Wee ũrĩ mwarĩ wa nyũkwa kũna, ũrĩa wanyararire mũthuuriwe na ciana ciake; na ũrĩ wa nyina kũna na aarĩ a maitũguo, arĩa maanyararire athuuri ao na ciana ciao. Maitũguo aarĩ Mũhiti, nake thoguo aarĩ Mũamori.
english: You are the daughter of your mother, who loathes her husband and her children; and you are the sister of your sisters, who loathed their husbands and their children. Your mother was a Hittite, and your father an Amorite.

kikuyu: Hĩndĩ ĩyo, niĩ na Niĩ nĩngahingia mwĩhĩtwa ũrĩa ndehĩtĩire maithe manyu, atĩ nĩngamahe bũrũri ũrĩ bũthi wa iria na ũũkĩ,’ na nĩguo bũrũri ũyũ mwĩgwatĩire ũmũthĩ.” Na niĩ ngĩmũcookeria atĩrĩ, “Kũrotuĩka ũguo, Jehova.”
english: that I may establish the oath which I swore to your fathers, to give them a land flowing with milk and honey,’ as it is today.” Then I answered, and said, “Amen, Yahweh.”

kikuyu: (Andũ othe a Athene na andũ a kũngĩ arĩa maatũũraga kuo matirĩ ũndũ ũngĩ meekaga tiga kwaria na gũthikĩrĩria ũhoro wa maũndũ marĩa mageni).
english: Now all the Athenians and the strangers living there spent their time in nothing else, but either to tell or to hear some new thing.

kikuyu: Rĩrĩa Athalia nyina wa Ahazia onire atĩ mũriũ nĩakuĩte-rĩ, akĩambĩrĩria kũniina nyũmba yothe ya ũthamaki wa Juda.
english: Now when Athaliah the mother of Ahaziah saw that her son was dead, she arose and destroyed all the royal offspring of the house of Judah.

kikuyu: Nī ma rangi wa ngirini na ngoikoni na mīkurura ya rangi mūtune kana pink na makanyakanya meerū, ngoikoni kana matune.
english: They are greenish-yellow with a red/pink blush and numerous white, yellow or red lenticels.

kikuyu: Haaragĩriai igongona rĩa njino, rĩa gategwa kamwe na ndũrũme ĩmwe na tũtũrũme mũgwanja o kamwe ka ũkũrũ wa mwaka ũmwe, ciothe itarĩ na kaũũgũ, irĩ ta mũtararĩko mwega wa gũkenia Jehova.
english: You shall offer a burnt offering for a pleasant aroma to Yahweh: one young bull, one ram, seven male lambs a year old without defect;

kikuyu: “Ũndũ ũyũ ũgũtuĩka watho mwandĩke wa kũrũmagĩrĩrwo hĩndĩ ciothe nĩ inyuĩ; horohio ĩrĩrutagwo riita rĩmwe o mwaka nĩ ũndũ wa mehia mothe ma andũ a Isiraeli.” Na gũgĩĩkwo o ta ũrĩa Jehova aathĩte Musa gwĩkagwo.
english: “This shall be an everlasting statute for you, to make atonement for the children of Israel once in the year because of all their sins.” It was done as Yahweh commanded Moses.

kikuyu: Mīthemba ya mītī irīa mīhande nīyo īgūteithia kūgīa na maciaro marīa merīgīrīirūo.
english: The type of avocado cultivars planted in an orchard will contribute to the expected yield.

kikuyu: Andũ arĩa angĩ nĩmakaiguaũhoroũcio nao metigĩre, naguoũndũũcio mũũru ndũgacookagwĩkwo rĩngĩ thĩinĩ wanyu.
english: Those who remain shall hear, and fear, and will never again commit any such evil among you.

kikuyu: Ũkĩmatheria ũgeekaga ũũ: Maminjaminjĩrie maaĩ ma kũmatheria thaahu; macooke menje njuĩrĩ cia mĩĩrĩ yao kũndũ guothe na mathambie nguo ciao, nĩguo metherie.
english: You shall do this to them to cleanse them: sprinkle the water of cleansing on them, let them shave their whole bodies with a razor, let them wash their clothes, and cleanse themselves.

kikuyu: Njamba īmwe yagīrīire kūheyo mīera ikūmi.
english: One cock should be used to serve 10 hens

kikuyu: No niĩ-rĩ, magũrũ makwa maratigĩtie hanini matenderũke; ndaarĩ o hakuhĩ kũgũa.
english: But as for me, my feet were almost gone. My steps had nearly slipped.

kikuyu: Nake Jesũ akĩringwo nĩ tha nyingĩ, agĩtambũrũkia guoko gwake akĩhutia mũndũ ũcio. Akĩmwĩra atĩrĩ, “Nĩ ngwenda. Therio.”
english: Being moved with compassion, he stretched out his hand, and touched him, and said to him, “I want to. Be made clean.”

kikuyu: ĩrĩa ĩtangĩigua rwĩmbo rwa mũmĩthuuthĩri, o na angĩkorwo aramĩthuuthĩra arĩ na ũũgĩ mũnene atĩa.
english: which doesn’t listen to the voice of charmers, no matter how skillful the charmer may be.

kikuyu: Na maita maingĩ yanagaikia mwaki-inĩ o na maaĩ-inĩ ĩkoorage. No akorwo nĩ harĩ ũndũ ũngĩka, tũiguĩre tha ũtũteithie.”
english: Often it has cast him both into the fire and into the water to destroy him. But if you can do anything, have compassion on us and help us.”

kikuyu: Nĩgũkorwo ndiaririe ndĩĩrĩte niĩ mwene, no Baba ũrĩa wandũmire nĩwe wanjathire ũrĩa ingiuga, na ũrĩa ingĩaria.
english: For I spoke not from myself, but the Father who sent me gave me a commandment, what I should say and what I should speak.

kikuyu: Ariũ a Gerishoni maarĩ: Ladani na Shimei.
english: Of the Gershonites: Ladan and Shimei.

kikuyu: “We ti mũndũ ta niĩ atĩ nĩguo ndĩmũcookerie, nĩguo tũngʼethanĩre igooti-inĩ.
english: For he is not a man, as I am, that I should answer him, that we should come together in judgment.

kikuyu: Na rĩrĩ, hĩndĩ ĩrĩa Herode aarĩ mũthamaki wa Judea, nĩ kwarĩ mũthĩnjĩri-Ngai wetagwo Zakaria, warĩ wa gĩkundi kĩa athĩnjĩri-Ngai kĩa Abija; mũtumia wake eetagwo Elizabethi na aarĩ wa rũciaro rwa Harũni.
english: There was in the days of Herod, the king of Judea, a certain priest named Zacharias, of the priestly division of Abijah. He had a wife of the daughters of Aaron, and her name was Elizabeth.

kikuyu: marigū ma kīmerera no marīmwo Kenya?
english: Is organic banana farming viable in Kenya?

kikuyu: Mũndũ mũtaana egunaga we mwene, no mũndũ ũtarĩ tha erehagĩra thĩĩna we mwene.
english: The merciful man does good to his own soul, but he who is cruel troubles his own flesh.

kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ ũcio tũgĩkĩhĩtũkĩra kũu kwa ariũ a ithe witũ, njiaro cia Esaũ, acio maatũire kũu Seiru. Nĩtwatigire barabara ya gũthiĩ Araba ĩrĩa yumĩte Elathu na Ezioni-Geberi, tũkĩnyiita barabara ya werũ ya gũthiĩ Moabi.
english: So we passed by from our brothers, the children of Esau, who dwell in Seir, from the way of the Arabah from Elath and from Ezion Geber. We turned and passed by the way of the wilderness of Moab.

kikuyu: Mũthenya wa mbere mũgĩe na kĩũngano gĩtheru, na mũtikarute wĩra ũrĩa mũrutaga.
english: In the first day you shall have a holy convocation. You shall do no regular work.

kikuyu: “ ‘Nĩ ũndũ ũcio, kwambĩrĩria mũthenya wa ikũmi na ĩtano wa mweri wa mũgwanja, mwarĩkia kũgetha irio bũrũri-inĩ, nĩ mũgaakũngũĩra gĩathĩ kĩu kĩa Jehova mĩthenya mũgwanja. Mũthenya wa mbere nĩ wa kũhurũka, na mũthenya wa ĩnana o naguo no wa kũhurũka.
english: “ ‘So on the fifteenth day of the seventh month, when you have gathered in the fruits of the land, you shall keep the feast of Yahweh seven days. On the first day shall be a solemn rest, and on the eighth day shall be a solemn rest.

kikuyu: Nĩ kĩĩ kĩragiria mũmenye atĩ ndikwaragia ũhoro wa mĩgate? No mwĩhũgagei ndawa ĩyo ya kũimbia mĩgate ya Afarisai na Asadukai.”
english: How is it that you don’t perceive that I didn’t speak to you concerning bread? But beware of the yeast of the Pharisees and Sadducees.”

kikuyu: Aranagĩriai mũndũ na ũrĩa ũngĩ na ciugo cia thaburi, na nyĩmbo cia kũinĩra Ngai, o na nyĩmbo cia kũguna maroho. Inagai na mũtungage na nyĩmbo ngoro-inĩ cianyu nĩ ũndũ wa Mwathani,
english: speaking to one another in psalms, hymns, and spiritual songs; singing and making melody in your heart to the Lord;

kikuyu: Thĩinĩ wa maũndũ macio mothe-rĩ, Ayubu ndaigana kwĩhia na ũndũ wa gũtuĩra Ngai mahĩtia.
english: In all this, Job didn’t sin, nor charge God with wrongdoing.

kikuyu: Thuutha wa mũgambo ũcio kũiguĩka, makĩona atĩ Jesũ aarĩ wiki. Nao arutwo magĩkira ki na ũhoro ũcio, gũtirĩ mũndũ o na ũmwe meerire matukũ-inĩ macio maũndũ marĩa moonete.
english: When the voice came, Jesus was found alone. They were silent, and told no one in those days any of the things which they had seen.

kikuyu: Wee Ngai, igua ihooya rĩakwa; thikĩrĩria ciugo cia kanua gakwa.
english: Hear my prayer, God. Listen to the words of my mouth.

kikuyu: Nao makiuma kũu magĩtuĩkanĩria bũrũri wa Galili, na Jesũ ndeendaga mũndũ o na ũrĩkũ amenye kũrĩa marĩ,
english: They went out from there and passed through Galilee. He didn’t want anyone to know it,

kikuyu: Nĩ ũndũ ũcio kĩũngano kĩu gĩkĩmũtwara nja ya kambĩ gĩkĩmũhũũra na mahiga nyuguto agĩkua, o ta ũrĩa Jehova aathĩte Musa.
english: All the congregation brought him outside of the camp, and stoned him to death with stones, as Yahweh commanded Moses.

kikuyu: Mũndũ mũkoroku arehagĩra nyũmba yake thĩĩna, no ũrĩa ũthũire mahaki nĩagatũũra muoyo.
english: He who is greedy for gain troubles his own house, but he who hates bribes will live.

kikuyu: Mũthamaki nĩagacakaya, nake mũrũ wa mũthamaki nĩakahumbwo gũkua ngoro, namo moko ma andũ a bũrũri ũcio nĩmakainaina. Na niĩ nĩngameka kũringana na mĩthiĩre yao, na ndĩmatuĩre ciira kũringana na ũrĩa magĩrĩire gũtuĩrwo. Hĩndĩ ĩyo nĩmakamenya atĩ niĩ nĩ niĩ Jehova.’ ”
english: The king will mourn, and the prince will be clothed with desolation. The hands of the people of the land will be troubled. I will do to them after their way, and according to their own judgments I will judge them. Then they will know that I am Yahweh.’ ”

kikuyu: Hĩndĩ ĩyo mũraika wa Mwathani akiumĩrĩra Zakaria, na akĩrũgama mwena wa ũrĩo wa kĩgongona kĩrĩa gĩa gũcinĩra ũbumba.
english: An angel of the Lord appeared to him, standing on the right side of the altar of incense.

kikuyu: Inyuĩ andũ arĩa mũrehaga ũhoro mwega Zayuni, ambatai mũthiĩ kĩrĩma-inĩ kĩrĩa kĩraihu na igũrũ. Inyuĩ arĩa mũrehaga ũhoro mwega Jerusalemu, anĩrĩrai na mũgambo mũnene, anĩrĩrai, na mũtigetigĩre; ĩrai matũũra ma Juda atĩrĩ, “Ngai wanyu arĩ haha!”
english: You who tell good news to Zion, go up on a high mountain. You who tell good news to Jerusalem, lift up your voice with strength! Lift it up! Don’t be afraid! Say to the cities of Judah, “Behold, your God!”

kikuyu: Makūraga wega matūra-inī marīa marī mita 800 nginya 1600 igūrū wa irīa.
english: Altitude; 800-1600meters above sea level

kikuyu: Gĩkundi gĩake nĩ kĩa andũ 59,300.
english: His division, and those who were counted of them, were fifty-nine thousand three hundred.
